free_tier.stated: Cheapest offer the tracker lists as currently sold: EUR 3.97 / month on a yearly term (the section lead reads 'starting at EUR 47.69 per year'), 1 Intel core (shared), 2,048 MB RAM, 3,000 GB HDD, 20,000 GB/month bandwidth, 1 Gbps port, IPv4 and IPv6, Bucharest, Romania. The tracker's own offer link names the plan VPS_STORAGE_38_year. The vendor's homepage read advertises the same product line as 'Cheap Storage VPS' at 'Starting at $1.00 /TB per month' and 'VPS KVM SSD' at 'Starting at $9.69 /mo', which corroborates the line and the unit price but not this plan's cores, RAM or disk.

egress.terms: the plan row states 20,000 GB/month of bandwidth as the included allowance; no per-GB overage price was published on the pages read

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
tooling: not stated on the pages read. The tracker's offer link points at the vendor's own order page, which was not fetched.
chaining: Three terabytes of HDD with 20 TB a month of transfer at EUR 3.97 is the cheapest per-TB archive slot, at the vendor's own stated unit price of about one euro per TB a month; the media is spinning HDD behind a shared 1 Gbps port, so it is a cold or warm store rather than a serving node.

limits.value: 20,000 GB a month on a 1 Gbps shared port. The 3 TB HDD is not the wall for an archive role; the monthly transfer is, and it is metered rather than shaped, so the first limit a crawler meets is the 20 TB count.

vendor homepage text, fragments quoted separately: the storage product card reads 'Cheap Storage VPS' with 'Storage 4-100TB HDD SAS 4kn RAID', 'Network 1+Gbps', 'Starting at $1.00 /TB per month' and, in the page's opening line, 'Starting at $1.00 per TB'; the other card reads 'VPS KVM SSD' with 'Starting at $9.69 /mo'; the page places both in 'Bucharest, Romania', datacenter 'M247 EUROPE'. notes: The page prints the euro sign; every figure here is spelled EUR to keep the strings ASCII. The plan row is tracker-only, which is why the confidence is reported and not documented.
